name: Chat history, empty
summary: No conversations yet: the heading, two lines of guidance, and a New chat button at the foot. Search and Select come out of the nav entirely.

looseEnds.title: New chat appears only on the empty states
looseEnds.detail: A 173x54 New chat button sits at the bottom right here and on the all-deleted frame, and nowhere else in the feature. A user with one chat has no way to start another from this page.
looseEnds.ask: Should New chat be on the populated page too?

looseEnds.title: The empty copy names the product and the heading does not
looseEnds.detail: 'Ask PC Chat™ a question today.' is the only place on the page the assistant is named. The heading stays 'Chat history'.
looseEnds.ask: Confirm the trademark symbol is wanted in body copy at this size.
